items.headline: NVIDIA reported Q1 fiscal 2027 results with record revenue of $68.1B and guided next-quarter revenue to $78B, above consensus
NVIDIA announced a multiyear partnership with Corning to expand U.S. manufacturing for AI infrastructure and optical connectivity
NVIDIA announced a strategic partnership with IREN to accelerate deployment of up to 5 gigawatts of NVIDIA DSX-aligned AI infrastructure
